data.summary: A customer support helpdesk application for managing tickets, with features for users, agents, managers, and premium users with SLA tracking.
ambiguities: The exact criteria for 'premium' access and how it is granted are not specified.
assumptions: Users will have accounts to submit tickets.
Managers will have read-only access to analytics.
Premium users are a subset of users who pay for SLA tracking.
SLA tracking is a premium feature.
